title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Sport Science (2015)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Sport Science (2015). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: _____ is covers a range of physical activities in which adults and young people participate?
questions.explanation: Sport encompasses a variety of physical activities for all ages.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a common health and fitness goal?
questions.explanation: Decreased water intake is not a health or fitness goal.

questions.questionText: One of the following is the objectives of physical education?
questions.explanation: Physical education aims to develop students physically, socially, and psychologically, making all of these valid objectives.

questions.questionText: A goal may be scored directly from the following except?
questions.explanation: A goal cannot be scored directly from a throw in.

questions.questionText: All are true regarding the purpose and goals of adapted physical Education, except ____
options: To take themselves as part and parcel of the so called 'normal children's'
To have a positive outlook towards others
questions.explanation: The goal is not to compare with 'normal children' but to facilitate individual progress.

questions.questionText: Among the following one is not the principles of Evaluation.
options: Evaluation should Based on clearly stated objectives
questions.explanation: Evaluation should be cooperative, not the opposite.

questions.questionText: What is the responsibility of educational sport psychologist?
questions.explanation: Educational sport psychologists are involved in teaching, guidance, and counseling.

questions.questionText: Which one is the basic principle of functional planning the indoor facility?
options: main storage area should be planned for maximum efficiency of operation
Indoor facility should be planned for equal use by both women and men
Planning and designing should accommodate handicapped and aged person.
questions.explanation: All options are principles of functional planning for indoor facilities.

questions.questionText: Of the following football techniques one refers to Transferring the ball from one player to another player?
questions.explanation: Passing is the technique used to transfer the ball between players.

questions.questionText: The norms that represent all similar subjects in Ethiopia is said to be:______
questions.explanation: National norm represents similar subjects across Ethiopia.

questions.questionText: If the player is sent-off due to injury or tactical reasons, so such types of the formation is called?
questions.explanation: An incomplete formation occurs when a player is sent off.

questions.questionText: Physiological compensation to environmental stress occurring over a period of time?
questions.explanation: Acclimatization refers to the body's adjustment to environmental stress.

questions.questionText: Which one is not the body measurement test?
questions.explanation: All listed options are body measurement tests.

questions.questionText: The game of volleyball is part of Olympic game in the year of?
questions.explanation: Volleyball was included in the Olympic Games in 1964.

questions.questionText: _____ is a type of tournament involves the elimination of all teams until only one winner remains and the teams which are defeated once or twice in the tournament get eliminated from the tournament.
questions.explanation: A knock-out tournament eliminates teams until one winner remains.

questions.questionText: The degree to which the test is actually measure what they set out to measure is called ___.
questions.explanation: Validity refers to how well a test measures what it is intended to measure.

questions.questionText: Which of the following one describes hypothermia?
options: condition in which the body loses too much salt and water
condition in which the body overheats and can't cool down
condition in which the body's core temperature drops too low
questions.explanation: Hypothermia is characterized by a dangerously low body temperature.

questions.questionText: What is a rotator cuff injury?
options: An injury to the knee from running
An injury to the elbow from weightlifting
An injury to the shoulder from repetitive overhead motions
questions.explanation: A rotator cuff injury specifically affects the shoulder.

questions.questionText: A kind of motivation is more temporary and it includes both tangible and intangible rewards from an outside source.
questions.explanation: Extrinsic motivation comes from external rewards.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not factors that affects in gymnastics?
questions.explanation: All listed factors can affect performance in gymnastics.

questions.questionText: Which one indicates patellar tendinitis?
options: An injury to the knee caused by jumping
An injury to the elbow caused by weightlifting
An injury to the shoulder caused by throwing a ball
questions.explanation: Patellar tendinitis is commonly associated with jumping activities.

questions.questionText: The process of deciding in advance what is to be done and method or techniques of looking ahead to devise a basis for the course of future action is called_____
questions.explanation: Planning involves setting objectives and determining a course of action.

questions.questionText: In handball this throw is awarded when a foul destroys a clean chance to score.
questions.explanation: A seven-meter throw is awarded for fouls that prevent scoring opportunities.

questions.questionText: Among the gives alternatives one is different from the other.
questions.explanation: Developing communication skills is distinct from the other options.

questions.questionText: Which of the following best describes the Correct Sequence of Coaching process in Athletics?
questions.explanation: The correct sequence is to plan, execute, and then review.

questions.questionText: Allowing an opportunity to the athlete to recover psychologically and physically from the training loads is the objective of ---------------------- Phase.
questions.explanation: The offseason is designed for recovery and preparation.

questions.questionText: Modern Olympic Games were Held in the First Time in ---------------
questions.explanation: The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens, Greece in 1896, organized by the International Olympic Committee under the leadership of Baron Pierre de Coubertin.

questions.questionText: In Basketball players if the players Dribble the Ball by two Hands the game will start by -----------
questions.explanation: Dribbling with two hands is considered an illegal dribble.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the formation of mental pictures of successful performances?
questions.explanation: Imagery involves creating mental pictures of success.

questions.questionText: The skill that takes place in a stable, predictable environment is called -------------
questions.explanation: Closed skills are performed in stable and predictable environments.

questions.questionText: The area of volleyball width by length respectively?
questions.explanation: The official dimensions of a volleyball court are 18m by 9m.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not a Shooting Technique?
questions.explanation: Blocking is a defensive action, not a shooting technique.

questions.questionText: One of the following is an organized competitive form of play?
questions.explanation: Sport is defined as an organized competitive form of play.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following characterize casual coaches Except?
options: Athletes perform the exercise according to their wish
questions.explanation: Casual coaches typically do not have a rigid training structure.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is/are training structure of Dictatorial coach?
questions.explanation: Dictatorial coaches often have nonflexible and rigid training structures.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not the causes of visual impairments?
questions.explanation: All listed options can cause visual impairments.

questions.questionText: A goal can be scored directly from the following Except?
questions.explanation: A goal cannot be scored directly from an indirect free kick. The ball must touch another player before entering the goal for it to count from an indirect free kick.

questions.questionText: Identify the odd from the give alternatives on African football federation founders.
questions.explanation: Ethiopia was not among the founding members of the Confederation of African Football (CAF). The four founding members in 1957 were Egypt, Sudan, Ethiopia, and South Africa. Tunisia joined later.

questions.questionText: The types of assessment which is undertaken during the course of training or project is called?
questions.explanation: Formative assessment is conducted during the training process.

questions.questionText: The Current Ethiopian Athletics Federation President and CAA vice President is ---------
questions.explanation: Commander Derartu Tulu is the current president of the Ethiopian Athletics Federation and CAA Vice President. Derartu Tulu is a two-time Olympic gold medalist in the 10,000 meters.

questions.questionText: When you made training which volleyball technique is relatively too difficult to perform?
questions.explanation: The spike is generally considered a more advanced technique.

questions.questionText: What is a stress fracture?
options: small crack in a bone caused by overuse
tear in a muscle caused by overuse
stretch or tear in a ligament caused by overuse
questions.explanation: A stress fracture is a small crack in a bone due to repetitive stress.

questions.questionText: A player is not in an offside position if:
options: He is in his own half of the fields of play
He is level with the second-last opponent
He is level with the last two opponents
questions.explanation: A player is not in an offside position if: they are in their own half of the field, they are level with the second-last opponent (usually the last defender other than the goalkeeper), or they are level with the last two opponents. All three conditions qualify for not being offside.

questions.questionText: How wide must the goal line between the goal posts?
questions.explanation: The goal line must be 6 cm wide.

questions.questionText: Who is the father of modern Gymnastics?
questions.explanation: Friedrich Ludwig Jahn (1778-1852) is widely recognized as the 'father of modern gymnastics'. He created the first open-air gymnasium in Berlin in 1811 and developed many gymnastics apparatuses.

questions.questionText: Cognitive stage of skill acquisition characterizes by all Except?
options: The athletes form a cognitive picture of the skill
questions.explanation: In the cognitive stage, athletes often commit more errors and do not perform independently.

questions.questionText: --------------- is an activity performed before exercise training program for 10 - 15 minutes.
questions.explanation: Warming up is essential before starting any exercise program.

questions.questionText: Handball game for holding the ball for more than three seconds without moving is?
questions.explanation: A free throw is awarded for holding the ball too long.

questions.questionText: The first step to design fitness test is_____
options: The test protocols need to be standardized.
Select specific test for specific fitness.
The test actually measures what they set out to measure.
questions.explanation: Ensuring the test measures what it is intended to measure is crucial.

questions.questionText: During exercise, the changes in the respiratory system are described as?
questions.explanation: The respiratory rate increases during exercise to meet oxygen demands.

questions.questionText: During exercise, the muscular system:
questions.explanation: The muscular system typically increases in size with regular exercise.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is Orderly Written in Shooting Basketball?
options: Balance; follow through, eye focus on the ring. Elbow directly to the ring.
Follow through, Balance; eye focus on the ring. Elbow
Balance, eye focus on the ring. Elbow directly to the ring, Follow through
Eye focus on the ring. Elbow directly to the ring, Follow through, Balance
questions.explanation: The correct sequence emphasizes balance and follow-through.

questions.questionText: On a penalty throw all players, except the goalie (goalkeeper) and the offensive player taking the throw, must stay outside of the?
questions.explanation: Players must remain outside the penalty-throw line during a penalty throw.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not A session Plan Content?
questions.explanation: Competition is not typically included in a session plan.

questions.questionText: What is tennis elbow?
options: An injury to the knee from playing tennis
An injury to the elbow from playing tennis
An injury to the wrist from playing tennis
questions.explanation: Tennis elbow refers to an injury to the elbow.

questions.questionText: When the game of volleyball ahead the best technique of receiving jump serves ball?
questions.explanation: The dig is the best technique for receiving jump serves.

questions.questionText: In the year ___________ International Handball Federation was formed?
questions.explanation: The International Handball Federation (IHF) was founded on July 11, 1946, in Copenhagen, Denmark. The 1928 date often referenced was for a predecessor organization.

questions.questionText: Which one is correct about Gymnastics?
options: Gymnastic is now one of the popular sports in Ethiopia, which is given in the school physical education curriculum.
The teacher of gymnastics and tumbling should be able to apply all of the psychological principles of teaching.
The first Olympics, held by the ancient Greeks in 776 B.C.
questions.explanation: All statements about gymnastics are correct.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not health impairment?
questions.explanation: All listed options are health impairments.

questions.questionText: Ethiopian Athletes has More Famous In the World in -------------------------- Events.
questions.explanation: Ethiopian athletes are renowned for their middle and long-distance running.

questions.questionText: All of the following are true about sport psychology Except.
questions.explanation: Sport psychology aims to enhance potential, not decrease it.

questions.questionText: Involving some parts of the muscle groups is the characteristics of ------------ skill.
questions.explanation: Fine skills involve precision movements using small muscle groups with high levels of hand-eye coordination, such as writing or threading a needle.

questions.questionText: A direct free kick is awarded to the opposing team if a player commits any of the Following offences /fouls/ except?
options: If the player impedes /delay the progress of an opponent
Kicks or attempts to kick an opponent
Trips or attempts to trip an opponent
questions.explanation: Impeding an opponent's progress without contact (obstruction) results in an indirect free kick, not a direct free kick. The other options (kicking, tripping, and pushing) are all direct free kick offenses as they involve physical contact.

questions.questionText: Identify the correct correspondence on skill of coaching.
questions.explanation: All options correctly correspond to coaching skills.

questions.questionText: IAAF is the Governing Body Athletics in the World. FIBB is Governing body of -------- in the World.
questions.explanation: FIBA (not FIBB) is the International Basketball Federation that governs basketball worldwide. IAAF (now World Athletics) governs athletics.

questions.questionText: Working beyond your comfort zone in training to force an adaption is a definition of which principle of training?
questions.explanation: The overload principle involves training beyond normal limits.

questions.questionText: What is altitude sickness?
options: condition in which the body's oxygen levels drop at high altitudes
condition in which the body's blood sugar drops too low
condition in which the body overheats and can't cool down
condition in which the body's oxygen levels increase at high altitudes
questions.explanation: Altitude sickness occurs due to low oxygen levels at high altitudes.

questions.questionText: Who is drawn up and published the first Handball game rules?
questions.explanation: Karl Schelenz is credited with developing the modern rules of handball in 1919. Holger Nielsen developed rules for an earlier variation, but it was Schelenz who established the foundation for the modern game.

questions.questionText: During the planning and development process, the challenge is to complete a facility project with the fewest number of errors. Those are:
options: Failure to plan for maintenance of the facility
Failure to plan for adequate supervision of the various activity spaces within the facility
Failure to provide adequate and appropriate accommodations for persons with disabilities throughout the facility
questions.explanation: All listed challenges can lead to errors in facility planning.

questions.questionText: Based on 3 – 5 – 2 playing system, which one of the following is true?
options: The system includes 2 defenders, 5 midfielders, and 3 attackers
The system includes 5 defenders, 3 midfielders, and 2 forwards
The system includes 3 defenders, 5 midfielders, and 2 attackers
questions.explanation: The 3-5-2 system represents 3 defenders, 5 midfielders, and 2 attackers. The numbers are always listed from defense to offense in soccer formation notation.

questions.questionText: It is possible the volleyball in one team at once pass contact four times; which ball?
questions.explanation: In volleyball, a team can have four contacts when the first contact is a block. Since a block is not counted as one of the three team hits, a team can touch the ball four times in this sequence: block, first hit, second hit, third hit.

questions.questionText: All are the causes of hearing impairment, except _____
questions.explanation: All listed options can cause hearing impairment.

questions.questionText: A men's team handball game consists of?
questions.explanation: A men's handball game consists of two 30-minute periods.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a good form of stress that can give you a feeling of fulfillment?
questions.explanation: Eustress is positive stress that can improve performance, motivation, and focus, leading to feelings of fulfillment and accomplishment. Unlike distress, eustress is beneficial and helps athletes perform at their best.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following represents the most superficial aspects of our personalities?
questions.explanation: Role-related behavior is the most superficial aspect of personality.

questions.questionText: Means of start volleyball game to play?
questions.explanation: The game of volleyball starts with a serve.

questions.questionText: What body type had broad shoulders and a muscular build?
questions.explanation: Mesomorphs are characterized by a muscular build and broad shoulders.

questions.questionText: The maximum Goal Score by a player in the game Of Basketball Is given by a referee?
questions.explanation: There is no limit to the number of points a player can score in a game.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a health dietary choice?
questions.explanation: Consuming fruits and vegetables daily is a healthy dietary choice.

questions.questionText: During involvement in exercise which statement indicates the incorrect changes of cardiovascular system?
options: Plasma volume increase during exercise, due to decreasing BP which increase the rate of plasma filtration from the vascular space.
The decrease in plasma volume is compounded by fluid loss through sweating. Stays the same
The decrease in blood volume will decrease preload and increase Heart rate.
During intense exercise in the heat the combined circulatory demands of muscle and skin can impair O2 transport.
questions.explanation: The plasma volume typically decreases during exercise due to sweating.

questions.questionText: ______ is the main criteria for participation in the early ancient Olympic Games?
questions.explanation: All listed criteria were required for participation in the ancient Olympic Games.

questions.questionText: Volleyball first name is called?
questions.explanation: Volleyball was originally called 'Mintonette' (not 'Minonett') when it was invented by William G. Morgan in 1895. The name was later changed to volleyball due to the volleying nature of the game.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is/are tactical elements that are specific to the game?
questions.explanation: All options are tactical elements specific to the game.

questions.questionText: If the Athletes made A False Start in Sprint Running the athlete will be ----------------------
options: Get a yellow and Red Card together
questions.explanation: A false start typically results in disqualification.

questions.questionText: Athletes do what they want, this styles of coaching refers to?
questions.explanation: Laissez faire coaching allows athletes to make their own decisions.

questions.questionText: The comparison of the weight of fat in your body to the weight of bones, muscles, skin and organs?
questions.explanation: Body composition refers to the ratio of fat to lean mass in the body.

questions.questionText: ----------- ----- is the Founder of Basketball in the world in 1891.
questions.explanation: Dr. James Naismith invented basketball in December 1891 at the International YMCA Training School in Springfield, Massachusetts. He created the game as an indoor activity for his students during the winter months.

questions.questionText: Which one is the Factors determined the type of tournaments that should be used?
options: The time available for each game and to finish the tournament
The interest of participants or expected teams participating the competition.
Number of courts or the availability of facilities and equipment
questions.explanation: All factors influence the type of tournament that should be used.

questions.questionText: If a player may make a bad tackle on an opponent because the opponent has been insulting/ teasing him throughout the game. So this types situation/aggression is an example of _______
questions.explanation: Hostile aggression occurs when the primary intent is to cause harm or injury to another person, often motivated by anger or frustration. In this case, the player tackles in response to insults, not to gain a tactical advantage.

questions.questionText: The Opponent team Score the Basketball return from the basketball Board is by using --- techniques?
questions.explanation: Rebounding is the technique used to score after a missed shot.

questions.questionText: High levels of self-confidence can promote:
questions.explanation: High self-confidence can enhance various aspects of performance.

questions.questionText: ______ is true, if it is performed with free will, for fun?
questions.explanation: Recreation is typically done for enjoyment and free will.

questions.questionText: Which one the following is not women Artistic gymnastics?
questions.explanation: The parallel bar is not a women's artistic gymnastics event.

questions.questionText: Athletes First, 'Winning Second' coaching philosophy is more in line with?
questions.explanation: The 'Athletes First, Winning Second' philosophy aligns with a democratic coaching style that prioritizes athlete development, wellbeing, and participation over winning at all costs. Autocratic and authoritarian styles tend to prioritize winning over athlete welfare.

questions.questionText: The reasons why we categorize persons with disability are ________
options: To group students for effective learning
questions.explanation: All reasons are valid for categorizing persons with disabilities.

questions.questionText: During exercise, the nervous system:
questions.explanation: The nervous system speeds up to enhance performance during exercise.

questions.questionText: Which of the Following body Type is MORE dominantly used for High Jump?
questions.explanation: Ectomorphic body types are typically more suited for high jump due to their lean build.

questions.questionText: ______ is an educational process, which aims to enhance total human development through movement within educational settings?
questions.explanation: Physical education focuses on human development through movement.

questions.questionText: Changing the playing system from 4 – 5 – 1 to 4 – 3 – 3 is an example of ------------ game strategy.
questions.explanation: Changing formations is a strategic decision related to team formation.

questions.questionText: All are processes functioning under the cover of sports management Except?
questions.explanation: Reporting is not typically considered a core process of sports management.
